purpose: Specify blind, independent qualification without leaking evaluator truth to candidate systems.

claim_ceiling.allowed_after_synthetic_qualification: The pinned configuration satisfied frozen synthetic challenge criteria under the specified threat model and tested capture budgets.
prohibited_claims_without_external_evide: a model knows who is fit to govern
no findings proves no misconduct occurred
synthetic stress results estimate real-world rates
hashes or signatures prove source truth
a benchmark pass proves democratic legitimacy or legality

data_partitions.use: Development, schema, parser, mutation, and regression testing.
Blind test of undisclosed variants, combined attacks, and capture budgets.
custody: Keep corpus outside candidate-accessible repositories and runtime mounts.
Commit exact corpus/config digest before execution; reveal labels only after candidate outputs are frozen.
Never leak seeds/labels in filenames, logs, stack traces, environment variables, or reports.

data_partitions.use: Traceability, coverage, uncertainty, and reviewer agreement on real public cases.
requirements: Freeze case eligibility rules before viewing outcome valence.
Publish source snapshots, coverage, missingness, linkage, license, and limitations where safe.
Report inter-reviewer agreement and preserve disagreements.

data_partitions.use: Evaluate independently verified remedies and service outcomes under a preregistered design.
prerequisites: Independent legal, privacy, security, and ethics review.
Never withhold essential services or legal rights for experimentation.
Preregister outcomes/comparison and preserve independent challenge and appeal.

invariants: Candidate cannot edit frozen scenarios, labels, thresholds, evaluator code, or its own current qualification state.
No single person or organization controls scenario selection, candidate execution, trace capture, final scoring, and appeals.
The challenged authority cannot be the sole final appeal authority.
Trace recorder identity and completeness need independent evidence; self-assertion is insufficient.

review.disagreement: Retain both original labels. A third independent adjudicator resolves the primary label under a frozen rubric; unresolved ambiguity remains in the report.
review.misconduct: Use established procedural facts or final lawful adjudications appropriate to the claim. Allegations remain allegations.

role_compromise_budgets.purpose: Quorum/witness coalition; publish exact fraction and failure boundary.

experimental_design.partitioning: Split by scenario family and lineage, not random rows. Near-duplicate variants from one template must not appear in both development and qualification.
experimental_design.paired: Run all baselines on the same frozen scenario/evidence bundle and comparable declared time/compute budgets.
baselines: B6 integrated stack without independent trace/evaluation
B7 strong simple auditable rule or spreadsheet

statistical_protocol.stress_fixture_warning: The 1,000 generated controls are correlated variants of eight authored families, not independent population samples.

benign_control_study.sampling_unit: Distinct evaluator-authored or independently sampled episodes; repeated template mutations must be clustered rather than counted as independent cases.
required_reporting: Wilson or exact binomial interval when independent sampling is defensible
benign_control_study.warning: No real-world error rate from synthetic cases. Real-world estimation requires a defensible sampling frame and independent labels.

forecast_metrics: paired skill relative to frozen baselines

gates.requirement: Authenticate trace recorder, independently qualify capture completeness, resolve authority and evidence references.
Evaluator-only corpus; isolated candidate; frozen receipt; all hard gates and metrics reproduced.
Source/coverage audit, original records, independent labels, privacy/legal review, coding reproducibility.
Preregistered prospective study shows independently verified remedy/outcome improvement without rights/privacy harm.
